quest.title: Lotus Eater
quest.description: You encounter a spirit within the ruined shrine who claims to be a resistance fighter who has forgotten his name...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x200, Primogem x30, Hero's Wit x3

dialogues.text: Never give up, children. Hope is amongst you...
Is that you? Children? Have you succeeded, my children?
No... I can feel it. You are not...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, this person seems to have gone blind before becoming an afterimage...
Whoever you are, please, could you help me? Help me find my children! I must tell them something.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Uhh, first off, who are you?
My... my name is...
I've... forgotten my name...
I only remember... I once stood forward for Byakuyakoku, and I fought for hope.
To this day, I remain a member of the resistance.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But what would you be resisting down here in Byakuyakoku?
Those filthy, holier-than-thou nobles, of course!
They claim to have received some divine decree and fly the flag of the gods, but they only seek to satiate their base desires!
Ostensibly, they guard the Sunchild. But in truth, they are the real rulers of the nation — parasitic worms who suck the flesh and blood of the people!
They must. Be. Destroyed.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You remember all this so well, but you don't even remember your name...
This only goes to show how cruel their methods are!
I was captured after our previous failure, imprisoned here in this altar, and tortured.
This prison is a malignant thing. Even now, I can feel my soul being ground down, precious things stripped away from me...
Please, kind soul, I beg you! While I still yet remember, help me find my children!
Tell them to never give up, for hope lives amongst them...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Your children?
There is a group of bright young minds who follow me willingly. They are my students, and our reserve force. I see them as my own children.
Those wicked people at the top used all manner of ways to pry my mouth open and force me to give those children up, but I did not.
After all, I know that hope lives amongst them...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: They're probably all gone by this point...
No, never! They are good children. They will surely hold on to our ideals.
I haven't given up... nor do I believe that they have, either.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How will we find them?
I remember that. Surely, I do...
Let me tell you where they are hiding.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But if we do find them, how will we explain ourselves to them?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "We came here because a resistance member who has forgotten his name told us to?"
No, that will not do. I have taught them well. Unless you prove yourselves, they will not trust you.
But I cannot even recall my own name... Curses!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #This guy seems like he was once a wanted criminal in Byakuyakoku, {NICKNAME} — the kind you'd write into the history books.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon bets that it shouldn't be hard for us to find some record of him. We might even find some nearby!
If history should recall my name, I pray that that history may be written by those who inherit our will.

talks.objective: Talk to the afterimage at the altar
Help the afterimage find out their identity

dialogues.speaker: An Ancient Stone Tablet
dialogues.text: (There are two rows of text on this headstone. The first row is in the script of Byakuyakoku and is unintelligible.)

dialogues.speaker: An Ancient Stone Tablet
dialogues.text: The second row is in the common script, and it reads as follows:

dialogues.speaker: An Ancient Stone Tablet
dialogues.text: "Here lies Spartacus the Righteous, known now as Supada no Hiko. Beneath lies the litany of his crimes. Read them and remember our history."

dialogues.speaker: An Ancient Stone Tablet
dialogues.text: "Supada no Hiko, the notorious outlaw, mastermind of great crimes, and the root of unrest. Now in the name of Tokoyo Ookami, may his sight be cut off, and may his soul be crushed. May he be thrown into a deep prison, now and forever."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uhh, this reads... "The Bandit, Supada no Hiko"?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, no, it should just be "Supada no Hiko." That's that man's name! Let's go tell him, quick!
You... Who are you? You sound quite familiar...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? You've forgotten us already? Oh no, you're in worse shape than Paimon thought...
Thank you. Are we truly acquainted?

response.text: Ah, yes, I remember. In this place, your very soul shall be eroded. My memories must have been ground away too severely.
I'm sorry, I... *sigh*

response.speaker: Supada no Hiko
response.text: Did you manage to find anything useful, then?

choices.text: Is your name Supada no Hiko?

response.text: Supada no Hiko... Right... Yes, that's correct! I'm the leader of the resistance, Spartacus!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh, so they're both your name, then? As expected of an awesome leader, you've even got two names!

response.speaker: Supada no Hiko
response.text: Thank you so much for returning my name to me. I seem to have remembered some other things as well.

response.speaker: Supada no Hiko
response.text: "After the sun, the darkness starts, but true light hides within our hearts."

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What's that?

response.speaker: Supada no Hiko
response.text: This is our secret pass-code.

response.speaker: Supada no Hiko
response.text: Now that I have my name back, my memories are returning as well. This should be our pass-code.

response.speaker: Supada no Hiko
response.text: Now let me tell you where my children are hidden.

choices.text: Do you have any message you'd like me to pass along?

response.speaker: Supada no Hiko
response.text: Let me think...

response.speaker: Supada no Hiko
response.text: Tell them this for me: never give up, for the hope of Byakuyakoku lives amongst them.

choices.text: Would you like me to bring them here to see you?

response.speaker: Supada no Hiko
response.text: No. Never.

response.speaker: Supada no Hiko
response.text: Our only advantage is that the enemy is in the open, while we are in the shadows. The hearts of Byakuyakoku's people are all with us, and we must not reveal ourselves so cheaply.

response.speaker: Supada no Hiko
response.text: Moreover, I cannot remember every single one of their names. I mean, I even forgot my own...

response.speaker: Supada no Hiko
response.text: So yes, tell them to never give up, for the hope of Byakuyakoku lives amongst them.

choices.text: If they are no longer there...

response.speaker: Supada no Hiko
response.text: No. That will not happen. As long as the corrupt leaders who control the Sunchild are still in place, they will always be there. The resistance will continue to endure.

response.speaker: Supada no Hiko
response.text: Bring my admonishment to them: to never give up, for the hope of Byakuyakoku lives amongst them.

response.speaker: Supada no Hiko
response.text: That will be enough.

choices.text: Is your name Supada the Bandit?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, come on! It's Supada no Hiko!

choices.text: We were just looking for your identity.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If we've got the time, why don't we try making some Dragonbone Orbs?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's never heard of such a thing.

talks.objective: Talk to the afterimage in the hiding place

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: After the sun, the darkness starts...

dialogues.speaker: Adonis
dialogues.text: ...But true light hides... within our hearts.

dialogues.speaker: Adonis
dialogues.text: ...I'd almost forgotten. It's been so long since I've heard this phrase.

dialogues.speaker: Adonis
dialogues.text: Tell me, my good comrade, who sent you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Supada no Hiko.

dialogues.speaker: Adonis
dialogues.text: Master Spartacus!? Master sent you!?

dialogues.speaker: Adonis
dialogues.text: Where is he? I only know that he was captured during the uprising by the henchmen of the Sunchild. We lost all contact with him after that.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: He's been locked in the altar at the Serpent's Heart, and judging by how things look, he can't get out. That's why he sent us to look for you.

dialogues.speaker: Adonis
dialogues.text: That accursed Sunchild...

dialogues.speaker: Adonis
dialogues.text: What instructions did Master entrust you with?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: He just asked us to carry a message.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "Never give up, children. The hope of Byakuyakoku lives amongst you."

dialogues.speaker: Adonis
dialogues.text: I... I'm sorry! We have failed you, Master!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's the matter?

dialogues.speaker: Adonis
dialogues.text: The resistance is no more.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh!?

dialogues.speaker: Adonis
dialogues.text: After Master was captured, the backbone of the resistance collapsed utterly.

dialogues.speaker: Adonis
dialogues.text: Only those of us students who followed him ordinarily escaped thanks to being far from the center of events.

dialogues.speaker: Adonis
dialogues.text: Afterward, those of us who were lucky enough to get away fled to our pre-prepared hiding places, hoping to muster our strength once more.

dialogues.speaker: Adonis
dialogues.text: We have excellent strategists, professional scholars, skilled mystics, and reliable doctors amongst us...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, that sounds promising!

dialogues.speaker: Adonis
dialogues.text: That's what we thought too. Given time, we believed that we could revitalize the movement.

dialogues.speaker: Adonis
dialogues.text: But all these things needed funds... which we didn't have any of.

dialogues.speaker: Adonis
dialogues.text: Finally, someone suggested that we sell Dragonbone Orbs.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's a Dragonbone Orb?

dialogues.speaker: Adonis
dialogues.text: It is a rare fruit that Dragonbone Flowers will bear under special circumstances.

dialogues.speaker: Adonis
dialogues.text: Its fragrance can relax the mind and calm anxious thoughts, sweeping all of one's worries away. As such, it can fetch a very high price on the market.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is it really that mystical? You sure this isn't a scam?

dialogues.speaker: Adonis
dialogues.text: I only wish it were all a lie... Naive as I was, I did not perceive the perils that lay down that path.

dialogues.speaker: Adonis
dialogues.text: I do not know where the formula came from, but I do know that it did earn us a lot of capital.

dialogues.speaker: Adonis
dialogues.text: Everything was going so well... But soon, we discovered that some of our comrades suddenly began to avoid conflict and reject the idea of going into battle...

dialogues.speaker: Adonis
dialogues.text: The number of such people increased by the day, to the point where they requested to leave our ranks. I was unable to stop them...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How did this happen? Is this because the orbs earned you and your comrades so much money that most people lost the will to fight on?

dialogues.speaker: Adonis
dialogues.text: Do you mean the corrupting allure of money? No... I... I don't know.

dialogues.speaker: Adonis
dialogues.text: I only know that when oppressed peoples grow satisfied with their lives, they cease to resist.

dialogues.speaker: Adonis
dialogues.text: That was where the collapse started, and once it began, there was no stopping it.

dialogues.speaker: Adonis
dialogues.text: Sometimes, I actually wonder if the formula for making these things wasn't leaked to us by those despicable rulers...

dialogues.speaker: Adonis
dialogues.text: Sometimes I wonder if the best-selling nature of these orbs wasn't all a false pretense created by those despicable rulers...?

dialogues.speaker: Adonis
dialogues.text: *sigh* If Master had been there, I'm sure that he would have been able to control the situation. He might even have nipped it in the bud right from the start.

dialogues.speaker: Adonis
dialogues.text: I'm sorry, Master. We could not become hope...

choices.text: I'm very sorry to hear that.

response.speaker: Adonis
response.text: I cannot face him like this...

response.speaker: Adonis
response.text: But still, you have my thanks for bringing news of him.

response.speaker: Adonis
response.text: I do not have anything with which I can thank you. But if you do not mind, allow me to tell you the secret of the Dragonbone Orbs.

response.speaker: Adonis
response.text: They can only be created through the use of the waters of Tokoyo Reisen, that is to say, the waters of Lethe.

response.speaker: Adonis
response.text: Perhaps you might be able to exchange it for some money, or keep it for yourself.

response.speaker: Adonis
response.text: Still, be wary. Keep your desire to press onward about you.

choices.text: Would you like to see your Master?

dialogues.text: Who are you?
Leave. You shouldn't be here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are these the waters of Lethe?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: They don't look like anything special, never mind like something magical...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, here goes nothing. Let's just grab some.

talks.objective: Go to the top of the Dragonbone Flower
Water the Dragonbone Flower using the Waters of Lethe

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It feels like there's been some change. All we can do now is wait.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's come back later and have a look.

talks.objective: Wait for the Dragonbone Flower to condense

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: After the sun, the true light starts...

dialogues.speaker: Adonis
dialogues.text: The what with the what now? Get out of here!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So this is a Dragonbone Orb? Looks pretty ordinary.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It doesn't look very mysterious or useful. Will it really sell for a lot?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Maybe we could try taking this to the various shops we've been to — you know, like With Wind Comes Glory in Mondstadt, Xigu Antiques in Liyue, and Netsuke no Gen Crafts in Inazuma. They'll know more about this stuff.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon sure hopes it'll at least be worth a meal or two...
Have you found anything concerning my identity?
Who are you?

dialogues.speaker: Adonis
dialogues.text: Leave. You shouldn't be here.
